_comment: Plan key -> Stripe Price ID + Checkout mode. TEST-mode IDs (sandbox acct_1UKoiZQ9sEpFpWZB). The checkout page passes ?plan=<key>; only keys listed here are accepted. To use different (e.g. live) Price IDs without a code change, set the STRIPE_PLANS_JSON env var to a JSON object of the same shape; it replaces this file entirely.
